title: Distinguishing Repetition Disfluency from Morphological Reduplication in Bangla ASR Transcripts: A Novel Corpus and Benchmarking Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on linguistic classification and ASR transcript normalization for the Bangla language. It evaluates models on their ability to distinguish grammatical structures from speech errors and does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
